# Ned offline adaptation

Original authors: GoogleChrome modern-web-guidance contributors; Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox and MDN teams, with the original guide attributions

Upstream: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance/blob/4dd968349e54ca45a05dd5c818fb035c9054b022/skills/modern-web-guidance/SKILL.md

Commit: 4dd968349e54ca45a05dd5c818fb035c9054b022

License: CC-BY-4.0; see LICENSE and CODE-LICENSE.txt. Preserve attribution and source links. Modifications by Ned contributors, 2026-11-13. The upstream authors do not endorse Ned.

This is a selective static host adapter, not an installation of the upstream executable plugin, CLI, agents or validators. The method was condensed for Korean/offline use. Online installation, telemetry, cloud services, automatic update, mandatory Q&A, external issue trackers and parallel-agent procedures were omitted. Tools map to Ned host reads/search, approved project edits and available reviewed runtimes. Missing executors and image generation remain explicitly unavailable.
